#### Release notes:

* We've added support for Makefiles, assembly source files and Windows DOS batch script files.
* The classic Lines Of Code (LOC) metric is now also available for more supported formats.
* The new rcnGetTextFormatLabel(), rcnIsLlcCountingSupported() and rcnIsLocCountingSupported() API functions can be used to query information about a specific text format via its correspnding enumerator.
* Other internal improvements.

See [Changelog](https://github.com/raven-computing/reckon/blob/v1.8.0/CHANGELOG.md).
